sources.title: Trade Everything demo common script
supports: Identifies demo USDC flows on the default exchange host.
limitations: Static source, not executed; no account endpoint was requested.

sources.title: Trade Everything landing/demo-host market summary
supports: Reports 208 supported stock/ETF metadata entries; ticker.quotes contains 208 unique tickers.
Names Pyth prices and Nasdaq most-active ranking as separate source scopes.
limitations: Default/demo-host metadata is not a chain-999 active-market or execution check.
No per-entry stock/ETF category is provided; classifications are not guessed from names.

sources.title: Retained STOX frontend market configuration
supports: The retained deployment file lists 60 market symbols with source group and class labels.
The file is configured for Robinhood Chain 4663; market activation is not verified.
limitations: Re-read retained bytes; no new request.
Company/asset identity and actual onchain market activation were not independently verified.
